text: 1367 introduces nsIMsgOutgoingListener with onSendStart(nsIRequest) and onSendStop(serverURI, exitCode, secInfo, errorMsg), replacing an overloaded nsIUrlListener path for mail. Accepted IDL retains that contract and sendMailMessage passes the listener directly to the selected outgoing server. Preserve the explicit transport/security context and localized terminal message instead of assuming a URL object carries every protocol’s error state. Earlier optional mailnews-URI knowledge is reused, not replaced. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Typed outgoing listeners separate cancelable start state from terminal send results
